is_true authenticated before
is_null? order_id not null? Probably eq not null. Use not is_null.
in_set order_id valid_orders
order_w1_status? maybe delivered? Not given. Assume order_w1_exchange_items matches? Hmm.

new_item_ids_count <=1

unchanged gift_card_balance? maybe changes if price diff. Hmm.

Frame unchanged vars: order_w2_status, order_w2_cancel_reason
